name: (JDM CARS+CUSTOM RIM)West Malaysia Driving
desc:
West Malaysia Driving is an open-world driving experience based on real locations across Malaysia.
Drive around multiple maps, explore realistic recreations of Malaysian cities, meet new friends and roleplay in the game!
Any form of cheating or exploiting is not allowed.

Note: This game is currently in Alpha and still has room for improvements
Remember to release your handbrake before driving
Playing on a computer is recommended for better graphic experiences

If you have any problems or questions about the game, make sure to join the communication server
UPDATE 0.33
Added Camber
Added RimOffset
Fixed BodyMaterial
Added Live Suspension Tuning
Fixed many bugs
Rebalanced modification prices
Added Ambient Sounds
Improved Track Hitbox
Time Attack leaderboard will reset on the 1st of every month at 8am
If more players race together, the rewards are increased for everyone

New Codes Drops at 7000 Likes!
